properties.name: Reading the design does not require owning it
properties.statement: A session that cannot take the write lock should still be able to READ the design — orientation, detectors, reports — rather than having no design brain at all. RocksDB supports this (open_for_read_only, open_as_secondary) but dynograph-storage does not expose it, so this needs an upstream change to a tag-pinned dependency. Six concurrent sessions on one machine is the actual working pattern, and today five of them get nothing.
